change_scope: Only wait(message:timeout:condition:); every byte outside this function is unchanged from baseline.
semantics: Check whole-case budget before and immediately after initial synchronous condition evaluation.
If initially ready, return without another AX evaluation even if the local polling deadline has elapsed.
If initially false, subtract its elapsed time from the original local deadline and fail without polling if no time remains.
Predicate callbacks do not start another condition evaluation at or after that same local deadline.
After the bounded waiter, check the whole-case budget before accepting completion; no deadline reset.
limitations: The local harness executes the byte-for-byte extracted wait/requireBudget bodies with a virtual clock and XCTest scheduling adapters, not actual XCTest or native AX.
CLT Swift 5.8 parse and standalone checks passed; actual iOS/XCTest execution is pending parent dispatch.
No commit, push, dispatch, retry, private data output, application changes or native assertion removal.
